description: This source file contains unit tests for the RingRange class, focusing on operations such as difference, complement, intersection, and containment. It uses Xunit for testing and defines multiple test methods to verify the correctness of ring range logic.

classes.name: RingRangeTests
classes.description: Unit tests for verifying the behavior of the RingRange class, including set operations and boundary conditions.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_EquallyDividedRange
methods.description: Tests difference operation on equally divided ring ranges.

methods.name: ComplementDoesNotIntersect
methods.description: Verifies that the complement of a range does not intersect with the original range.

methods.name: ComplementComplementIsEqual
methods.description: Checks that double complement returns the original range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_HolePunch
methods.description: Tests differences that create holes (gaps) within the ring ranges.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_Empty
methods.description: Verifies that difference with an empty range returns the original range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_Empty_Two
methods.description: Tests difference when both ranges are non-empty and compares results.

methods.name: RingRangeIntersection
methods.description: Checks set difference results for empty and full ranges.

methods.name: RingRangeContains
methods.description: Verifies containment checks across various ranges, including wrapped ranges.

methods.name: EqualRangeInvariants
methods.description: Validates that equally divided ranges partition the max uint value correctly, without overlaps.
